SELECT ti.id AS template_item_id, ti.template_id AS template_id, ti.master_kpi_id AS master_kpi_id, km.code AS master_code, km.name AS master_name, km.category_id AS category_id, kc.name AS category_name, km.type_code AS type_code, km.unit_code AS unit_code, km.calculation_rule_code AS calculation_rule_code, km.calculation_type_code AS calculation_type_code, ti.default_target_value AS default_target_value, ti.default_weight AS default_weight FROM kpi_template_items ti INNER JOIN kpi_templates kt ON kt.id = ti.template_id AND kt.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN kpi_master km ON km.id = ti.master_kpi_id AND km.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN kpi_categories kc ON kc.id = km.category_id AND kc.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ti.template_id = #{templateId} ORDER BY km.code NULLS LAST, km.name ASC
